"'''Eel'''" was a [[sea eel]] owned by a young [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] during the period of [[Time/Legends|time]] when he lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Known only as "[[Eel/Legends|Eel]]," Fett's pet ate [[Sea-mouse|sea mice]]. When Boba and his [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], left Kamino to travel to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], Boba threw Eel into the Kaminoan [[Ocean/Legends|sea]]. The [[Water/Legends|sea]] eel was swiftly eaten by a larger [[Fish/Legends|fish]], causing the [[Youngling/Legends|boy]] to remark "good riddance."<ref name="TFtS" /> However, [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later as an older [[Gender/Legends|man]], Fett remembered Eel fondly, and regretted that the animal had died in such a manner.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Kaminoan sea eel known only as "Eel" made its first appearance in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2002]] young reader novel, ''[[Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive]]'', by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Terry Bisson]]. Several years later, with the release of the penultimate entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' entitle ''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'', and written by [[Karen Traviss]], Eel received a mention during a moment of Boba Fett's internal reminiscence.
